written: 2026-10-19, before any independent page is selected or fetched
status: BLOCKED: no active owner policy authorises these requests (see report section 1); nothing has been fetched

candidate.configuration: guided86c, all five S86c controls on (role, subject, repeats, boundary, structure)
candidate.code: src identical to commit ec9d4bb; hashes and per-category reading identities in freeze.json

comparators.B: operational default reading (no plan): the production path
comparators.C: plan-guided reading without controls (S86b): diagnostic only

notAPrimaryCandidate: configuration E (subject decided by the Step 1D-A entity inventory) was prototyped on the spent pages and rejected before any fresh data (report section 4); it is not run

sample.pages: 24 (minimum 18 if the budget or eligible pages run out; stop rule: no replacement after a page is read except documented technical failure)

strata.U_unseen_publishers: >= 16 pages from >= 4 hosts absent from the 72 hosts PEE examined before (freeze.json leakageExclusion)
strata.S_seen_publishers_unseen_pages: <= 8 pages from the S80 hosts (trustedreviews, expertreviews, housefresh), never one of the 239 excluded URLs: separates template generalisation from content generalisation

sample.categories: the six taught categories (air fryers, coffee machines, dehumidifiers, dishwashers, air purifiers, televisions), 4 pages each; coffee machines and dehumidifiers compile only 2 measurements each, so their recall measures teaching depth as much as the reader
sample.layouts: >= 6 comparison or roundup pages (several products), >= 6 pages with result tables, >= 6 single-product prose reviews
sample.selection: per (host, category) cell: one web-search query 'site:{host} {category noun} review tested'; results in rank order; the first eligible result (HTML review of products the publisher states it tested; not in the exclusion list; not paywalled) is taken; the full ranked list and each eligibility decision are logged and hashed BEFORE any page request

acquisition.requests: <= 40 in total (pages, robots.txt, redirects and retries count)
acquisition.gate: scripts/phase246-live-wave.mjs with --policy under the S85 wave gate; robots, 403/429, Retry-After and Content-Signal honoured
acquisition.retention: page bytes private (private-eval), never committed; live store untouched (store copies only)

reference.annotators: Claude agents given only worksheets of the visible page text (scripts/s86d-worksheets.py): blind to the implementation and its outputs, NOT independent human validation
reference.agreement: 25% of pages annotated twice by different agents: role agreement (Cohen kappa) and subject agreement reported; disagreements adjudicated by a third agent before scoring
reference.sealed: hash of all annotations committed before the first reading

primaryEndpoints.E1_recovery: correct stored results (measured result stored on the reviewed product, or another product's result stored unresolved), D vs B, per page; page-bootstrap 95% interval (2000 resamples, seed 86)
primaryEndpoints.E2_false_evidence: share of D's stored rows that are not measured results; target point <= 5% and bootstrap upper <= 10%
primaryEndpoints.E3_wrong_product: share of D's stored rows that are another product's result on the reviewed product; target point <= 2% and bootstrap upper <= 5%
primaryEndpoints.E4_legacy: only-old set (B correct, D not) = 0; any member is investigated and reported

secondary: every endpoint per stratum, category, publisher and layout
role classification of set-aside observations against the reference
downstream: Phase268 validation refusals of D's stored rows
scoring: scripts/s86d-page-score.mjs (scorer v2.1: first mentions, one-to-one anchored matching, value-only matches never credited); every pairing of D and B audited by hand
interpretation: Targets met in stratum U support considering admission (and expose the downstream gate as the next obstacle); met only in S indicates template overfitting; E3 failure on unseen publishers points to the missing product-versus-feature distinction (report section 4). Thresholds are reference points, read with their intervals, not proof of general capability.
afterTheFirstRun: the first run is committed unchanged; any change made after inspecting these pages is development on them, and a further claim of generalisation needs new pages
